concepts.description: A modular unit representing the AUV system architecture.
A platform representing the physical robotic system within the AUV module.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV module interact.
A control unit within the AUV module responsible for managing operations.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module to represent simple values.
A structured data type defined within the AUV module that records multiple related values.
A named value within a Composite Type, with a specified type.
A data field defined within an Interface, representing a specific piece of information exchanged between components.
An action or trigger defined within an Interface that can be sent or received by components of the AUV module.
A computational unit defined within the AUV module that takes inputs and returns a result.

instances.description: The module that encapsulates the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV that uses the Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
The interface providing sensor data to the AUV platform.
The interface providing actuator control to the AUV platform.
The controller responsible for operator-level control of the AUV, using the Inputs interface.
The interface used by controllers to receive input commands and requests.
The Last Response Engine controller that uses both Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
The interface used by controllers to send output commands such as velocity and heading advisories.
The autopilot controller of the AUV that uses the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A field of type real in SVec representing the radial component of the spherical vector.
A field of type real in SVec representing the polar component of the spherical vector.
A field of type real in SVec representing the azimuth component of the spherical vector.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng values.
A field of type real in Obstacle representing the north-south relative distance.
A field of type real in Obstacle representing the east-west relative distance.
A field of type real in Obstacle representing the depth of the obstacle.
A field of type real in Obstacle representing the identifier of the obstacle.
A field of type SVec in Obstacle representing the heading of the obstacle.
A value of type SVec representing the heading, contained in the Sensors interface.
A value of type Obstacle representing a detected obstacle, contained in the Sensors interface.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling the end of a task.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an obstacle collision manoeuvre.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a mission objective manoeuvre.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a heading change manoeuvre.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters, returning a real value representing the requested velocity.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters, returning a real value representing the requested heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a heading.
A composite type recording horiz_cda, vert_cda of type real, and id of type nat, representing close-distance approach data.
A field of type real in Close representing the horizontal close-distance approach value.
A field of type real in Close representing the vertical close-distance approach value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
